rows.question: 请核算2026年7月各型号在售出30天内的激活率，排除观察期不满30天的设备，给出分子、分母和百分数。

assessment.reason: 分组和数值与独立Python计算一致

rows.sql: WITH "sales_devices" AS (SELECT "bd"."device_id" AS "device_id", "dp"."product_id" AS "product_id", "dp"."product_name" AS "product_name", "fo"."paid_date" AS "paid_date" FROM "fact_order" AS "fo" INNER JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "foi" ON "fo"."order_id" = "foi"."order_id" INNER JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "bd" ON "foi"."item_id" = "bd"."item_id" INNER JOIN "dim_device" AS "dd" ON "bd"."device_id" = "dd"."device_id" INNER JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "dd"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" WHERE "fo"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-07-31' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE)), "activation_events" AS (SELECT "sd"."device_id" AS "device_id", "sd"."product_id" AS "product_id", "sd"."product_name" AS "product_name", "sd"."paid_date" AS "paid_date", "fa"."activation_date" AS "activation_date" FROM "sales_devices" AS "sd" LEFT JOIN "fact_device_activation" AS "fa" ON "sd"."device_id" = "fa"."device_id") SELECT "activation_events"."product_id" AS "product_id", "activation_events"."product_name" AS "product_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "activation_events"."device_id") AS "denominator", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "activation_events"."activation_date" IS NULL AND "activation_events"."activation_date" >= "activation_events"."paid_date" AND "activation_events"."activation_date" <= "activation_events"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN "activation_events"."device_id" END) AS "numerator", ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "activation_events"."activation_date" IS NULL AND "activation_events"."activation_date" >= "activation_events"."paid_date" AND "activation_events"."activation_date" <= "activation_events"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN "activation_events"."device_id" END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT "activation_events"."device_id"), 2) AS "activation_rate_pct" FROM "activation_events" AS "activation_events" GROUP BY "activation_events"."product_id", "activation_events"."product_name" ORDER BY "product_id" LIMIT 1001
